title: syntharc: The Grand Unified Synthetic Data Generator
summary: syntharc is a unified Python library that exposes a single prepare/fit/generate lifecycle for generating synthetic tabular, text, image, and time-series data, backed by engines like PyTorch, Hugging Face, Albumentations, and SDV. Its tabular and time-series modules wrap SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and PARSynthesizer directly, and its evaluation modules call SDV's evaluate_quality for quality scoring.
